MPG Gallery

roughVizR Team

October 27, 2025

Source: vignettes/mpg-gallery.Rmd
mpg-gallery.Rmd
library(roughVizR)
library(ggplot2)

The ggplot2::mpg dataset gives us real-world fuel economy measurements across dozens of vehicle models. This vignette turns those observations into a playful gallery of rough, sketch-inspired charts using roughVizR.

Prepare the dataset

We will derive a few helpful summaries for later use:

mpg_data <- mpg

avg_hwy <- aggregate(hwy ~ class, data = mpg_data, FUN = function(x) round(mean(x), 1))
colnames(avg_hwy) <- c("class", "avg_hwy")

manufacturer_counts <- aggregate(model ~ manufacturer, data = mpg_data, FUN = length)
colnames(manufacturer_counts) <- c("manufacturer", "model_count")
manufacturer_counts <- manufacturer_counts[order(-manufacturer_counts$model_count), ]
manufacturer_counts <- head(manufacturer_counts, 8)

class_counts <- as.data.frame(table(mpg_data$class))
colnames(class_counts) <- c("class", "count")

palette_main <- c("#ef476f", "#ffd166", "#06d6a0", "#118ab2", "#073b4c", "#f25c54", "#8338ec", "#ffb703")

The palette above leans on saturated hues so that each category pops even with the edgy line work that roughVizR applies.

Average highway mileage by vehicle class 

roughBar(
  avg_hwy,
  labels = "class",
  values = "avg_hwy",
  title = "Average Highway Mileage",
  color = palette_main[1],
  highlight = palette_main[4],
  axisFontSize = "0.9rem",
  margin = list(top = 60, right = 40, bottom = 90, left = 160)
)

Average highway mileage by vehicle class

Most common manufacturers in the dataset 

roughBarH(
  manufacturer_counts,
  labels = "manufacturer",
  values = "model_count",
  title = "Top Manufacturers in MPG",
  color = palette_main[6],
  highlight = palette_main[1],
  axisFontSize = "0.9rem",
  margin = list(top = 60, right = 50, bottom = 90, left = 180)
)

Top manufacturers by number of models

Vehicle class mix 

roughPie(
  class_counts,
  labels = "class",
  values = "count",
  title = "Vehicle Class Share",
  colors = palette_main,
  legend = TRUE,
  legendPosition = "right"
)

Distribution of vehicles by class

Highway mileage vs. engine displacement 

classes <- sort(unique(mpg_data$class))
scatter_colors <- palette_main[seq_along(classes)]

roughScatter(
  mpg_data,
  x = "displ",
  y = "hwy",
  colorVar = "class",
  colors = scatter_colors,
  title = "Mileage vs. Engine Size",
  axisFontSize = "0.9rem",
  radius = 9,
  margin = list(top = 60, right = 40, bottom = 80, left = 90)
)

Highway mileage as a function of engine displacement

The scatter plot maps highway mileage (hwy) to the vertical axis and engine displacement (displ) to the horizontal axis. Coloring the points by vehicle class highlights how compact cars dominate the high-efficiency zone while SUVs cluster toward the lower right.

With roughVizR, you can swap in different fields from mpg (or any tidy data source) and keep the hand-drawn aesthetic without extra effort.
